content.summary: Options ranked by time-to-learning for getting OpenCode MCP tools to appear with Claude Agent SDK.

data.problem: OpenCode MCP tools do not appear in the tool list when using Claude Agent SDK V2 because unstable_v2_createSession does not accept or wire mcpServers, so in-process MCP servers are ignored.
constraints: Need OpenCode MCP tools available in model tool list.
Prefer minimal integration changes and fast validation.
In-process MCP server is ideal but not required if it blocks progress.

options.name: Use V1 query API with setMcpServers
options.approach: Replace V2 session usage with V1 query() (streaming input) and call setMcpServers or pass options.mcpServers using createSdkMcpServer output; wrap Query to emulate session send/stream if needed.
options.what_we_learn: Whether MCP tools appear when using supported V1 MCP configuration; confirms tool naming/allowedTools filters.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium: may require small refactor of streaming/session wrapper.

options.name: Keep V2, externalize MCP server via CLI settings
options.approach: Run OpenCode MCP server as stdio/http/sse and register it in Claude Code settings so V2 picks it up from CLI config; keep V2 session code unchanged.
options.what_we_learn: Whether V2 surfaces MCP servers from settings and whether externalizing is viable operationally.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium: extra infra/config and loss of in-process context.

options.name: Patch/fork SDK to add V2 mcpServers support
options.approach: Fork claude-agent-sdk and wire SDKSessionOptions.mcpServers through to the internal Query/setMcpServers path; update dependencies.
options.what_we_learn: Whether V2 can support in-process MCP with minimal upstream changes.
options.risk_if_wrong: High: ongoing maintenance and upgrade friction.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it uses the SDK's supported MCP path (query + setMcpServers) and yields the fastest confirmation that OpenCode tools can appear without forking or external servers.
